caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate teapot centered within a lightly outlined square on a rectangular, yellowed background. The teapot is rendered in grayscale pencil, showcasing a reflective metallic texture. It features a bulbous lower body that narrows slightly before flaring outward at the top. The spout is long and curved, extending leftward from the body, while the handle is thick, highly stylized, and curves outward to the right. The lid of the teapot is dome-shaped with a small finial at the top, and there is a horizontal band around the widest part of the body for decoration. The light and shadowing give the object a three-dimensional appearance. The artist’s signature, “Ewing,” is present in the lower right corner of the outlined square.
title: Pewter Coffee Pot
